description.text: At night, a tall stone lighthouse stands on a rocky headland against a churning black sea. Rain sheets sideways in the gale, and waves burst into white spray against the rocks below. The lantern room is dark; only a faint warm glow shows in one low stairwell window as the storm batters the tower.
The dark lighthouse holds against the storm as rain drives across the headland.
Howling wind and driving rain lash the stone.
Surf crashes against the rocks below.
A low roll of thunder moves offshore.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

Inside the tower, a weathered lighthouse keeper in a dripping oilskin coat climbs a tight iron spiral staircase. One hand grips the cold rail while the other holds a lit hand lantern that throws swinging shadows across the curved stone wall. He leans into the climb, boots ringing on the treads, as the tower shudders around him.
The keeper steps onto the spiral stairs and begins to climb, lantern swinging.
Boots ring on the iron treads.
The lantern handle creaks softly.
Muffled wind buffets the tower while rain hammers the outer wall.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude.

The keeper pauses at a narrow storm window, rain streaking the glass. Lightning flashes across his rain-wet face as he sets his jaw, tightens his grip on the lantern, and pushes on upward. A gust rattles the frame and snaps his coat, but he keeps climbing with renewed effort.
The keeper reaches the storm window and pauses, lantern held high.
Glass rattles in a gust.
A sharp crack of thunder rolls over the tower.
Fabric snaps and heavy breathing marks his renewed effort.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

In the lantern room, the keeper lifts a burning taper to the great lamp's wick. Flame catches, the fresnel lens blooms with blinding white light, and a rotating beam sweeps out through the rain in a long arc across the black sea. The keeper steps back, lit from within the glare, as the tower becomes a beacon against the storm.
The keeper raises the taper to the wick.
The taper flares with a soft whoomph as the flame catches.
A low hum rises from the lamp.
The fresnel lens blooms and the rotating beam sweeps out through the rain.
The orchestral score swells and resolves.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
